successors.name: Vinča culture
successors.text: the Serbian core, the Banat and south-west Transylvania

successors.name: Linear Pottery culture
successors.text: the Koros group of the Hungarian plain, "named after the river Koros in eastern Hungary and western Romania"

ledger.x: 6000 BCE: the first farmers of the Balkans, the Starcevo-Koros-Cris villages, hold the Danube and Tisza plains.
5400 BCE: the Vinča culture takes the Morava-Danube core.
5300 BCE: the Koros group ends and the Alföld Linear Pottery takes the Hungarian plain.
5300 BCE: the last Starcevo-Koros-Cris land on the map, the north-west Balkans, goes to nobody.

certainty.note: An archaeological culture: radii around the type regions, never a frontier.
